kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §9 L270: W-12 shows a three-line template (W-14) as selectable static text with real line breaks and a CMP-033 CopyButton (W-13); it asks for the screen, what was tried and the app version, nothing else: no name, no health or disability question, no screenshot; nothing is stored by the app

kids.name: value-2

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The copied text goes to the owner by the team's existing internal channel; copying works offline

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: A repeat press announces at most once per state change (§9)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: §7.9 L252: a11y.problem_report_copied {} on a successful copy (PROPOSED)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Waits on D13-G3 (no client analytics path carries a11y.statement_viewed (MXR:23 defers the same))

kids.name: value-1

kids.name: value-2
